topic: Various safety precautions to be followed when working in hangar, GSE and on aircraft.
syllabus_extract: Various safety precautions to be followed when working in hangar, GSE and on aircraft.
specific_objectives: 21.1.9.1 Trainee will be able to explain various safety precautions to be adhered when working in A/C hangar

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of PPE usage, identification of fire extinguisher types, and proper grounding of GSE.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of wearing PPE in the hangar?
Why must personnel avoid loose clothing near rotating machinery?
What is the immediate action if a fire is detected in the hangar?

development.content:
Personal Protective Equipment requirements
Fire safety and extinguisher types
Electrical safety and grounding procedures
Handling of hazardous materials
General hangar housekeeping rules

topics: Safe operation of Ground Support Equipment
development.content:
Safe operation of Ground Support Equipment
Pre-flight and post-flight safety checks
Emergency evacuation procedures
Communication protocols during maintenance
Lockout/Tagout procedures

topics: Review of specific aircraft hangar restrictions
development.content:
Review of specific aircraft hangar restrictions
Case studies of hangar accidents
Q&A session on safety protocols
Reiteration of emergency assembly points
Final safety checklist walkthrough

summary_questions: Explain the correct procedure for grounding a GSE vehicle before connecting it to an aircraft.
Describe the specific safety precautions required when working near high-voltage electrical systems in the hangar.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the safety precautions to be observed during the next practical training session on DI/DR procedures (LP 14).
